user.title: Connect to ICT Protege
user.description: Enter the Automation and Control service details. Protege WX web operator credentials are optional and are used only to retrieve programmed names during scans.

abort.no_devices: No devices of this type have been configured yet.

configure_arming.title: Arming Panel Options
configure_arming.description: Select which arming modes should be visible on the Alarm Panel card.

add_door.title: Add Door
add_door.description: Enter the ID from the 'Reporting ID' or 'Record' column in Protege.

add_area.title: Add Area
add_area.description: Enter the ID from the 'Reporting ID' or 'Record' column in Protege.

add_input.title: Add Input
add_input.description: Enter the ID from the 'Reporting ID' or 'Record' column in Protege.

add_output.title: Add Output
add_output.description: Enter the ID from the 'Reporting ID' or 'Record' column in Protege.

scan_all.title: Scan All Devices
scan_all.description: Scan database record IDs starting at ID 0. If WX web operator credentials are configured, programmed names are retrieved automatically and sparse database IDs are handled correctly.

edit_confirm.title: Rename Device
edit_confirm.description: Enter the new name for device ID {id}.

configure_connection.title: Connection Settings
configure_connection.description: The WX web operator username/password are optional. When supplied they are used only for read-only name lookup during scans; the Automation and Control Service PIN remains responsible for monitoring and control.

scan_doors.title: Scan Doors
scan_doors.description: Scans from database ID 0 up to the selected maximum. With WX web credentials configured, actual programmed door names are used.

scan_areas.title: Scan Areas
scan_areas.description: Scans from database ID 0 up to the selected maximum. With WX web credentials configured, actual programmed area names are used.

scan_inputs.title: Scan Inputs
scan_inputs.description: Scans from database ID 0 up to the selected maximum. With WX web credentials configured, actual programmed input names are used.

scan_outputs.title: Scan Outputs
scan_outputs.description: Scans from database ID 0 up to the selected maximum. With WX web credentials configured, actual programmed output names are used.
